meta.name: 2D Platformer Template
meta.based_on: Hollow Knight / Celeste / Shovel Knight conventions
meta.description: Animation requirements for a 2D side-scrolling platformer character. Covers movement, attacks, reactions, and environmental states.
meta.notes: Platformers need smooth transitions between ground and air states. Walk cycles are the most visible animation — invest frames here.

movement.label: Core Movement
movement.description: Ground and air locomotion — the animations players see 90% of the time

attacks.label: Combat
attacks.description: Melee/ranged attacks, usually 2-3 tiers of power

special.label: Special Abilities
special.description: Character-specific powers, double jump effect, dash trail

states.name: idle
states.label: Idle / Standing
states.description: Standing still. Subtle breathing or character-specific idle animation.
states.generation_prompt: idle standing animation, subtle breathing, character standing relaxed on ground

states.name: walk
states.label: Walk / Run Cycle
states.description: The MOST IMPORTANT animation. Must look smooth. Character moves forward with clear stride.
states.generation_prompt: walk cycle, 6 frames side by side, character walking forward with distinct leg positions showing full stride, arms swinging naturally
common_issues: legs moving in sync (wrong — they alternate)

states.name: jump_rise
states.label: Jump Rise
states.description: Leaving the ground. Usually a crouch-to-stretch motion, then upward pose.
states.generation_prompt: jump takeoff animation, character crouching then launching upward, legs tucking, arms up

states.name: jump_peak
states.label: Jump Peak / Float
states.description: At the apex of the jump. Character is airborne, limbs tucked or extended.
states.generation_prompt: character at peak of jump arc, airborne, slight float, arms out for balance

states.name: jump_fall
states.label: Jump Fall
states.description: Falling downward. Hair/clothes should float UP. Legs spread for landing.
states.generation_prompt: character falling downward, hair floating upward, legs spread preparing for landing, arms out
common_issues: hair falling down instead of up

states.name: jump_land
states.label: Jump Land
states.description: Landing impact. Character bends knees to absorb. Quick transition back to idle.
states.generation_prompt: character landing from jump, knees bent absorbing impact, slight squash

states.name: attack_light
states.label: Light Attack
states.description: Quick basic attack. Startup → active → recovery. Fast and snappy.
states.generation_prompt: quick attack animation, wind-up then slash/strike then recovery, 4 frames, fast and snappy motion

states.name: attack_heavy
states.label: Heavy Attack
states.description: Slower, more powerful attack. More anticipation, bigger impact.
states.generation_prompt: heavy attack animation, big wind-up, powerful strike with impact effect, then slow recovery, 6 frames
common_issues: impact effect too large for frame

states.name: hurt
states.label: Hurt / Damage Reaction
states.description: Reacting to taking damage. Flinch backward, arms up defensively.
states.generation_prompt: hurt reaction animation, character flinching backward from impact, arms raised defensively, pained expression

states.name: death
states.label: Death / KO
states.description: Character defeated. Dramatic but quick. Ends on a grounded pose.
states.generation_prompt: death animation, character collapsing, dramatic fall, ending lying on ground, 5 frames

states.name: climb
states.label: Climbing
states.description: Climbing a wall or ladder. Alternating hand-over-hand motion.
states.generation_prompt: climbing animation, character on wall/ladder, hands reaching up alternately, legs following
common_issues: hands moving in sync (wrong — they alternate)

states.name: push
states.label: Push / Pull
states.description: Pushing a heavy object. Character leans forward, legs brace.
states.generation_prompt: pushing animation, character leaning forward with effort, legs bracing against ground, pushing heavy object
common_issues: object not present to push against
